questions.text:
9. [Maximum mark: 8]
The times taken for male runners to complete a marathon can be modelled by a normal
distribution with a mean 196 minutes and a standard deviation 24 minutes.
(a) Find the probability that a runner selected at random will complete the marathon in less
than 3 hours. [2]
It is found that 5 % of the male runners complete the marathon in less than T1 minutes.
(b) Calculate T1 . [2]
The times taken for female runners to complete the marathon can be modelled by a normal
distribution with a mean 210 minutes. It is found that 58 % of female runners complete the
marathon between 185 and 235 minutes.
(c) Find the standard deviation of the times taken by female runners. [4]
